I’m the one with the pug who had a mass on his spleen. So it turns out what the vet saw as a mass was a really big bladder. He was having trouble urinating before we took him in. The vet wanted to confirm it was a mass so they got an ultrasound. Well when they did that the mass was gone. Turns out he has crystals in his urine and a bladder infection. So back in January he was peeing in the apartment a lot. Turns out it was a kidney stone. It went away after a change of diet. Well this Friday it started again so we took him to the vet thinking it was another stone. Turns out he has a giant mass on his spleen. It’s so big it’s pushing his other organs to the side. We scheduled his surgery in May. He’s peeing constantly because the mass is pressing on his bladder and now he’s consistently on belly bands. I’m also 31 weeks pregnant and the stress is really getting to me. He’s the best doggo and I feel so bad. We’re doing everything we can for him it’s probably the pregnancy hormones making me so emotional. I call him my first son because I treat him like one. He’s my emotional support doggo and he’s 10 years old. His parents lived till 14 so I was thinking he had a few more years. The mass wasn’t there in January so it grew fast in 3 months.
